title: Do a check-in visit
summary: Check-in visits: open the visit, take the five photos, the odometer, damage, tires, fluids and warning lights, then Save the visit.

steps.text: Check-in visits: Booked first, then Due and Overdue. Overdue is soft: the visit is a suggestion to the renter, never a fee.
Press Do the visit on the car in front of you.
Take the five photos: front, rear, left side, right side and the odometer. Each one uploads as you take it.
Type the odometer reading in km. It goes into the car's maintenance, which shows the next service due.
Any new damage? Yes, with where and what, logs it for the Admins with your photos.
Measure the tire tread (the lowest, in mm). Under 3 mm raises a Fleet To do.
Check the oil, coolant and washer, and note any warning light on the dashboard.
Press Save the visit. Anything to look after becomes a To do; the visit shows on the booking's timeline and the owner's car page.
